notes.problem: A mauve-brown haze sky over lavender block trucks, the deck's worst value break, lamps as soft blurs.
notes.fix: Re-stage in the near black sky with the fog darkened, pool the key on the near two rows only, hard emissive pod points.

notes.problem: Fifty identical low poly trucks are a count not a subject, lavender cabs, a warm brown haze in the top half.
notes.fix: Eye at about 8 m at the yard's south edge so the front row fills the lower half in a pool, the rest fogged to the cool dark, CH.warm taken off.

notes.problem: Fifty low poly cabs in grey-blue mid tones under a warm haze band, breaking the deck's navy and black.
notes.fix: Light only the near two rows, let rows three to five fall to black with only their pod lamps, and remove the brown fog band.

notes.problem: A teal mid tone room and a striped UI field.
notes.fix: Wall and room fill near black, the reviewer's shoulder or hand in silhouette in the foreground.

notes.problem: The value strobe of the deck with a lit teal wall, the grid reads as barcode stripes, the cyan title bar reads as a UI screenshot.
notes.fix: A near black wall and zero room bounce, delete the title bar, one tile value with a dark gutter on every tile.

notes.problem: A generic kit monitor in an empty dark room, the screen reads as grey static at feed size, the most mid tone frame, nothing says a person reviews each one.
notes.fix: Seat a kit person, back to camera, in silhouette across the left third against the screen, with the screen the only source.

notes.problem: The subject a narrow sliver on the right edge and the label floating 170 px from the tag.
notes.fix: Camera left and closer so the upright, the butts and the bare arm fill the right 40 percent with the arm in its own pool, the label beside the tag.

notes.problem: The rack a 260 px sliver at the right edge, 70 percent dark, the bare arm not distinguishable at 432, a flat cyan tag, the label far from it.
notes.fix: Frame 5's camera at fov 34 square on so the upright and seven arms span 40 to 60 percent of the width, the pool on the seventh arm, a shaded card tag with a cast, the label directly left of the bare arm.

notes.problem: The rack squeezed into the right 15 percent, two thirds empty fence, the label about 400 px from the tag it names.
notes.fix: Pull the camera back and left so the upright and its seven arms fill about 40 percent of the width at centre right, the label beside the blank tag.

notes.problem: A toy-like pod, a flat cyan lens and a pale boom slab behind it.
notes.fix: Darken or retexture the boom as blue enamel in shadow, a coated glass lens with a key-lit rim and recessed bezel.

notes.problem: Faceted flat cyan lens and a pale low poly shape behind the pod.
notes.fix: A high segment glass lens with a clearcoat reflection, and hide or darken the pale boom shape.

notes.problem: Primitive pod with a flat cyan lens and a pale lavender polygon behind it at the frame's brightest point.
notes.fix: Delete or darken the pale boom shape and give the lens an inner iris ring and a rim-lit bezel.

notes.problem: A primitive box under flat tiled brick, the letter a small glyph.
notes.fix: Displaced brick with recessed mortar, camera at about 1.4 m pushed in so the box and letter take the focal third.

notes.problem: Reads as a dumpster of logs, the white truck a sliver, a dull body wall, no ground, two limbs through the wall.
notes.fix: Swing to the driver side rear quarter at about 2.5 m so the white cab side takes the key and the curb and contact enter the bottom third, and lift the piercing limbs.

notes.problem: Five empty arms on the second upright pre-empt the turn, untapered limbs, labels touching the upright.
notes.fix: Remove the unused arms from the second upright, taper the limbs with lit cut ends, shift the labels about 20 px right.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
work_order: no judge found a hard fail, and the median 6.896 is under this round's rung of 8.0. KEEP EDITING: fix the judges' named defects, re-render and re-score. At the round cap the finished deck ships whatever it scored. Start with the frames the judges charge the art for, in this order, slides 2, 4, 8, 3, 6, 1, 5 (`artwork_weakest_frames`), one concrete change each
craft_floor: pending, because a deck under its rung is sent back by the work order first
